modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Promo Team Lead - Brazil
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Promo Team Lead - Brazil em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Pocket FM


Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.


At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.


Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.


Role Overview


We are looking for a creative and execution-focused Promo Team Lead to lead the end-to-end creation of promotional ads, trailers, and performance creatives for Pocket FM audio series in the Brazilian market.


As a Promo Team Lead, you will manage a team of promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and dubbing partners to create high-quality promotional ads for Pocket FM audio series.


The role requires strong understanding of promo creation, ad storytelling, localization, dubbing workflows, quality control, team management, and creative optimization. You will oversee fresh promo creation, adaptation of ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese, production quality, timely delivery, and reworks for ads that are not meeting performance benchmarks.


Key Responsibilities


1. Team Leadership & Creative Direction

  • Lead and guide promo writers, sound engineers, video editors, and external dubbing partners.
  • Provide creative direction across writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video editing, and final delivery.
  • Ensure the team is well-utilized, motivated, and aligned with business and creative goals.
  • Build a high-ownership culture focused on quality, speed, and performance.

2. Promo Creation & Localization

  • Oversee the creation of fresh promo ads, trailers, and long-form promotional scripts for audio series.
  • Adapt successful ads from other geographies into Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Ensure all promos are culturally relevant, emotionally engaging, and suitable for Brazilian audiences.
  • Guide the team on hooks, story setup, emotional beats, cliffhangers, and audience entry points.

3. Production & Quality Control

  • Own the end-to-end promo production process from brief to final asset delivery.
  • Quality check every stage, including writing, dubbing, audio mixing, video creation, and final output.
  • Review scripts, VO/dubbing output, audio edits, video cuts, captions, and final creatives.
  • Ensure every asset meets Pocket FM’s creative, language, production, and performance standards.

4. Dubbing Agency Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard dubbing agencies for Brazilian Portuguese production.
  • Coordinate with agencies for script handover, voice casting, recording, revisions, and delivery.
  • Review dubbing output for pronunciation, emotion, pacing, tone, and character fit.
  • Track agency timelines, pending deliverables, feedback loops, and final submissions.

5. Performance Reworks & Optimization

  • Review ads that are not meeting benchmark metrics and identify key creative issues.
  • Create detailed and actionable rework hypotheses to improve ad performance.
  • Suggest improvements such as stronger hooks, sharper conflicts, better pacing, improved localization, or revised visuals.
  • Guide the team in creating alternate openings, new versions, and stronger creative angles.
  • Apply campaign learnings to improve future promo concepts and execution.

6. Process, Tracking & Reporting

  • Maintain show-level trackers for all ads being written, adapted, dubbed, edited, reviewed, and delivered.
  • Track ownership, status, timelines, delays, feedback, and final delivery for each asset.
  • Share weekly progress reports with the India team and relevant stakeholders.
  • Create SOPs, checklists, and workflows to avoid leakages across the production process.

7. AI Tool Adoption

  • Use GenAI tools for ad writing, ideation, VO production, image creation, video creation, and workflow improvement.
  • Guide the team in using AI tools to improve speed, quality, and efficiency.
  • Continuously explore new AI tools and workflows for promo production.
  • Ensure AI-assisted outputs are reviewed for storytelling quality, cultural accuracy, and production readiness.

8. Market & Audience Understanding

  • Apply strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption habits, and market trends.
  • Ensure promos feel native, relevant, and compelling for Brazilian audiences.
  • Stay updated on digital ads, audio entertainment, trailer formats, and performance creative trends.


Qualifications


  • Degree in Filmmaking, Marketing, Advertising, Media, Communications, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in ad creation, promo creation, trailer development, marketing creatives, ad copywriting, or performance creative production.
  • Strong understanding of marketing, ad storytelling, promo creation, and audience engagement.
  • Experience leading creative or production teams, including writers, editors, sound engineers, or external vendors.
  • Excellent command of English and Brazilian Portuguese.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian consumer behavior, content consumption patterns, and cultural nuances.
  • Experience working with dubbing agencies, VO artists, production teams, or post-production vendors.
  • Skilled in GenAI tools for writing, VO production, image creation, video creation, and creative workflow improvement.
  • Ability to create SOPs, trackers, review systems, and scalable creative processes.
  • Strong analytical ability to review ad performance and convert insights into actionable creative reworks.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.
  • Strategic thinker with strong ownership and business growth orientation.
  • Understanding of performance marketing on Meta and UAC is a plus.


Ideal Candidate


The ideal candidate is a creative leader who understands storytelling, promo production, and performance-driven advertising. They should be able to lead a multi-functional team, manage dubbing partners, maintain strong quality control, and deliver high-quality promo assets at scale.

They should have strong knowledge of Brazilian audiences, excellent creative judgment, hands-on production understanding, and the ability to turn performance feedback into clear creative action.


Language requirements

  • Fluent Portugese
  • Professional working proficiency in English


This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.


Salary for this position is R$ 7,000 - $10,000 BRL.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence) para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de excelência de serviços do Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC).

Essa pessoa terá atuação estratégica, sendo responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e relevância dos indicadores utilizados na gestão da performance, ao mesmo tempo em que apoia a construção e evolução de métricas sempre que necessário.

O papel exige forte interface com áreas de negócio, operação e times de dados/BI, traduzindo necessidades operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores acionáveis, confiáveis e alinhados aos objetivos do CSC.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de desempenho do CSC;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Atuar na definição de conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo e qualidade;
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação junto às áreas de negócio e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na priorização e gestão do backlog de indicadores considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção de frameworks de governança e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor evoluções contínuas;
  • Realizar interface com times de BI e dados para implementação das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis e mensuráveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando a tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação ou pós-graduação em TI, Engenharia, Estatística, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência com definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e métricas operacionais;
  • Experiência em atuação com stakeholders e áreas de negócio;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de performance e gestão de indicadores;

description:

Your next opportunity is on the way!


VILT is an IT company where we value our people, promote teamwork, and of course, good humor.


We believe that diversity and inclusion make our team stronger. Everyone is welcome here, and professionals with disabilities are encouraged to apply.

Take a look at this job opportunity and see if you are the next VILTian! (and if you know someone, don’t forget to recommend them)


We’re looking for a Senior Kotlin Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll design, build, and maintain backend services that power our applications, working closely with frontend and product teams to deliver scalable, reliable, and secure APIs.

  • CLT employment type;
  • Working schedule follows the Portugal time zone.


If you’re ready to take your engineering career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Salesforce Solution Architect
description:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Salesforce Solution Architect altamente qualificado(a) para liderar o desenho de soluções de ponta a ponta em implementações, melhorias e integrações na plataforma Salesforce.

Esse(a) profissional atuará como autoridade técnica, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em arquiteturas escaláveis, seguras e de alta performance, alinhadas às melhores práticas e ao roadmap da Salesforce.

O perfil ideal combina forte conhecimento técnico hands-on com visão estratégica, excelente comunicação e capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa ao longo do ciclo de entrega.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenho de soluções de ponta a ponta para implementações, melhorias e integrações Salesforce
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em arquitetura técnica, modelos de dados e desenho de soluções
  • Definir e documentar arquitetura de sistemas, padrões de integração e modelos de segurança
  • Atuar como autoridade técnica nas diferentes clouds Salesforce (Sales, Service, Experience, etc.)

  • Participar de workshops de discovery, revisões de solução e decisões técnicas
  • Identificar riscos, restrições e trade-offs antecipadamente e propor estratégias de mitigação
  • Apoiar estimativas, dimensionamento de soluções e atividades de pré-venda quando necessário
  • Colaborar com Product Owners, BAs, Desenvolvedores e QA ao longo de todo o ciclo de entrega


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Solution Architect ou Technical Architect em projetos Salesforce
  • Forte conhecimento prático em:
  • Sales Cloud e Service Cloud
  • Modelagem de dados e arquitetura de compartilhamento/segurança
  • Ferramentas de automação (Flows, Apex, Validation Rules)
  • Padrões de integração (REST, SOAP, Platform Events, Middleware)
  • Experiência no desenho de soluções multi-cloud e de nível enterprise
  • Sólido entendimento dos limites da plataforma, performance e governança
  • Excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos
  • Capacidade de liderar discussões técnicas e influenciar decisões arquiteturais

title: Nuclear Projects Implementation Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Nuclear Projects Implementation Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring an Implementation Manager / Engineer  to support customer implementations for a SaaS platform used in complex operational environments.


This role is focused on implementations for a major U.S.-based nuclear energy customer. The ideal candidate has direct experience supporting implementation projects connected to nuclear power plants, nuclear facilities, nuclear energy operations, or nuclear engineering environments . 


This is a customer-facing role that requires strong project execution, technical coordination, documentation discipline, and the ability to manage implementation work in a highly regulated, safety-sensitive environment. 


The right candidate will be comfortable coordinating business, operational, engineering, technical, and vendor stakeholders while ensuring that implementation milestones, documentation, testing, rollout, and handover are completed with clarity and control. 


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead customer implementation projects from kickoff through deployment and operational handover.  
  • Coordinate implementation timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and status reporting.  
  • Serve as a primary point of contact during customer implementation phases.  
  • Work directly with customer operational, technical, engineering, and project stakeholders.  
  • Support implementation activities connected to nuclear power plant or nuclear energy environments.  
  • Manage implementation documentation, workflows, requirements, and customer-facing project materials.  
  • Coordinate testing, validation, issue resolution, rollout readiness, and go-live activities.  
  • Troubleshoot implementation blockers and coordinate internal or external support when needed.  
  • Ensure clear communication across customer teams, internal teams, vendors, and technical stakeholders.  
  • Support onboarding, user adoption, training coordination, and operational transition.  
  • Maintain disciplined project governance in environments with strict documentation, approval, and risk requirements.  
  • Support process improvement and standardization of implementation practices.  


Required Experience

  • Direct experience implementing software or operational systems for nuclear power generation customers is required. 
  • Experience managing technical, operational, infrastructure, engineering, or software implementation projects.  
  • Experience implementing software platforms, SaaS solutions, enterprise systems, maintenance systems, operational systems, or digital workflow solutions within nuclear power generation environments. 
  • Familiarity with common nuclear operations and maintenance systems, terminology, and workflows.  
  • Customer-facing project or implementation management experience.  
  • Strong stakeholder management across technical, operational, and executive audiences.  
  • Experience coordinating implementation documentation, project plans, timelines, risk logs, status reports, and handover materials.  
  • Experience supporting testing, rollout, deployment, commissioning, validation, or go-live activities.  
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.  
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, remote environment.  
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.  
  • Brazil-based or authorized to work from Brazil for this customer environment.  


Preferred Experience


  • Experience with systems such as IBM Maximo or similar enterprise asset management platforms is highly preferred. 
  • Experience implementing SaaS, enterprise software, operational systems, infrastructure systems, telecom systems, engineering systems, or project control platforms.  
  • Experience with U.S.-based customers or multinational stakeholders.  
  • Experience in highly regulated, safety-sensitive, or mission-critical environments.  
  • Familiarity with nuclear project documentation, approval workflows, testing discipline, operational restrictions, or regulated handover processes.  
  • Experience with change management, user adoption, customer onboarding, or operational rollout.  
  • Background in engineering, IT, telecom, infrastructure, industrial operations, project controls, or energy-related environments.  
  • Strong candidates may come from consulting, software implementation, or professional services organizations supporting nuclear energy customers.

title: Strategy & Operations Manager (Revenue)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Strategy & Operations Manager (Revenue) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

At Revolut, Operations means problem-solving at scale. Our team tackles the company’s toughest challenges with speed, precision, and creativity. They design systems that unlock efficiency and power global growth.

We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to work on high-impact initiatives throughout the business, using insight to solve challenges, scale processes, and deliver better outcomes for our customers.

Watch this video from our team members about what goes into being a Strategy & Operations Manager at Revolut.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you’ll be doing

  • Building and optimising scalable processes to continue Revolut's hyper-growth
  • Leading and executing core infrastructure projects end to end
  • Exploring and defining which projects the team should prioritise, and setting a timeline to reach goals quickly
  • Searching for new features to provide a seamless customer experience
  • Managing critical vendor relationships and building performance tracking systems
  • Developing strategic supply chain partnerships and negotiating commercial terms

What you'll need

  • At least a 2:1 degree from a top university
  • 2+ years of work experience in a fast-paced environment
  • A solid track record of taking ownership and leading complex projects
  • The ability to break complex problems into smaller ones
  • To enjoy working with data
  • Natural curiosity and a will to make an impact
  • An interest in the financial industry

Nice to have

  • Experience coding with SQL, Python, and/or R

Compensation range

  • Krakow: PLN15,700 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Poland: PLN15,700 - PLN35,800 gross monthly*
  • Other locations: Compensation will be discussed during the interview process

*Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, skills, and previous experience

title: Consultor SRE com foco em Observabilidade
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consultor SRE com foco em Observabilidade em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos à procura de um(a) Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade, para se juntar ao nosso time de profissionais excepcionais na RÓDIO TECH.


Buscamos um(a) Especialista SRE com foco em Observabilidade, com sólida experiência em engenharia de confiabilidade, monitoramento de ambientes distribuídos e gestão de incidentes críticos. Um(a) profissional com domínio técnico em ferramentas como Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace, e com profundo conhecimento em práticas modernas de observabilidade, rastreamento distribuído e automação de alertas. Esperamos alguém que atue de forma estratégica, proponha padrões técnicos, eleve a maturidade dos nossos sistemas e dissemine boas práticas de visibilidade, performance e resiliência em toda a organização. O candidato ideal é colaborativo, analítico, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de dono, sempre alinhado aos valores e à visão da empresa.


Atividades a serem desenvolvidas:


Como Especialista SRE, essa pessoa será protagonista na evolução da plataforma de observabilidade da Empresa. Trará valor ao consolidar métricas, logs e rastreamentos em soluções robustas, garantindo visibilidade em tempo real, diagnóstico preciso de falhas e resposta eficiente a incidentes. Sua atuação será decisiva para o aumento da confiabilidade dos serviços, redução de indisponibilidades, melhoria contínua da performance e apoio estratégico às áreas de tecnologia e produto. Com sua expertise, teremos uma operação mais preditiva, escalável e resiliente. 


• Liderar a implementação e evolução da plataforma de observabilidade, consolidando logs, métricas e traces.

• Definir, padronizar e manter painéis e alertas para serviços críticos da organização.

• Estabelecer e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade (SLIs, SLOs), orientando decisões técnicas com base em dados.

• Automatizar respostas a alertas e reduzir o toil por meio de scripts e integrações entre ferramentas.

• Atuar na gestão de incidentes: triagem, coordenação de resolução, documentação e melhoria contínua.

• Apoiar squads de produto e infraestrutura na análise de performance e comportamento dos sistemas.

• Desenvolver e disseminar boas práticas de observabilidade nos ciclos de desenvolvimento e operações.

• Conduzir treinamentos técnicos sobre métricas, rastreamento e diagnóstico de aplicações.

• Evoluir continuamente o processo de detecção proativa e resposta rápida a falhas.

• Apoiar auditorias e relatórios técnicos com dados precisos de disponibilidade e incidentes.


Principais conhecimentos:

• Observabilidade ponta a ponta com Zabbix, Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) e Dynatrace.

• Criação, padronização e manutenção de dashboards operacionais, executivos e técnicos.

• Implementação e monitoramento de SLIs, SLOs e SLAs alinhados a objetivos de negócio.

• Rastreamento distribuído (Distributed Tracing) com Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger ou similares.

• Monitoramento de ambientes em nuvem (AWS, Azure) e conteinerizados (Kubernetes, Docker).

• Integração com ferramentas de alerta e resposta a incidentes: Opsgenie, PagerDuty, VictorOps.

• Automação de processos operacionais e scripts para coleta e análise de dados (Python, Shell, PowerShell).

• Participação ativa em war rooms, execução de post-mortems e condução de RCA (Root Cause Analysis).

• Criação e manutenção de documentação operacional (runbooks, playbooks, checklists).

• Colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, infraestrutura e produto para antecipação de riscos e padronização de visibilidade.


Perfil acadêmico e habilidades:

• Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência sólida e comprovada como SRE, Observability Engineer ou DevOps com foco em monitoramento.

• Domínio técnico de Zabbix, Elastic Stack e Dynatrace em ambientes de missão crítica.

• Forte entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e métricas operacionais.

• Vivência com rastreamento distribuído e integração de logs/métricas em pipelines CI/CD.

• Capacidade de correlacionar dados de observabilidade com impacto no negócio.

• Experiência com cloud computing (AWS, Azure, GCP) e orquestração de contêineres (Kubernetes).

• Fluência em automação com linguagens como Python, Shell Script, Go ou similares.

• Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo com múltiplas áreas.

• Visão sistêmica, senso crítico e iniciativa para liderar projetos de melhoria contínua. Qualificações Desejáveis:

• Certificações em observabilidade e confiabilidade: Dynatrace Associate, Zabbix Certified, Elastic Observability, SRE Foundation.

• Conhecimento em Prometheus, Grafana, Loki e OpenTelemetry.

• Experiência com Chaos Engineering e validação de resiliência.

• Participação em incidentes críticos com liderança técnica na resposta.

• Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços e desafios de visibilidade em ambientes distribuídos.

• Experiência com automação de runbooks e fluxos de resposta a incidentes.

• Familiaridade com práticas de FinOps e eficiência operacional em observabilidade.

• Participação em comunidades técnicas de SRE, DevOps e observabilidade.

• Contribuições para ferramentas ou boas práticas open source.

• Inglês técnico para leitura, escrita e participação em fóruns internacionais. 


Modelo de contratação:


  • Contrato: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ)


Modelo de atuação:


  • Modelo: 100% Remoto


Na RÓDIO TECH, conectamos os melhores profissionais às melhores vagas. Se você se identifica com esse perfil e busca uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa que valoriza o talento e a inovação, inscreva-se agora mesmo!

title: Business Development Manager- Crypto Sector
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Development Manager- Crypto Sector em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Meu cliente é uma exchange de criptomoedas líder no mercado.


O que você vai fazer:

• Identificar e executar iniciativas de prospecção junto aos principais projetos do setor.

• Avaliar projetos para compreender proposta de valor, vantagens competitivas, experiência da equipe e tração comercial.

• Analisar e recomendar ações de suporte: programas de incentivo de rendimento (yield), incentivos de aquisição de usuários, suporte técnico, suporte de marketing e introduções a outros parceiros.

• Avaliar e monitorar métricas-chave de projetos de criptomoedas, medir a efetividade de parcerias e campanhas, e recomendar ações corretivas quando necessário.

• Coletar feedbacks de parceiros e da comunidade e recomendar melhorias.

• Gerenciar projetos de desenvolvimento de negócios e iniciativas estratégicas conforme demanda.


Quem você é:

• Forte paixão e crença no ecossistema de criptomoedas. Espera-se que o candidato conheça os principais aplicativos DeFi e tenha entendimento sobre o funcionamento de protocolos AMM e de empréstimo/captação.

• De 2 a 5 anos de experiência em consultoria, desenvolvimento de negócios em blockchain ou pesquisa na área.

• Habilidades de análise financeira — capacidade de modelar planos de negócios e retorno sobre investimento.

• Forte senso de responsabilidade e autonomia, com capacidade de conduzir tarefas com pouca supervisão.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação.

• Experiência anterior em desenvolvimento de negócios em CeFi ou DeFi é um diferencial.

title: Nuclear Projects Implementation Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Nuclear Projects Implementation Manager em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are hiring an Implementation Manager / Engineer  to support customer implementations for a SaaS platform used in complex operational environments.


This role is focused on implementations for a major U.S.-based nuclear energy customer. The ideal candidate has direct experience supporting implementation projects connected to nuclear power plants, nuclear facilities, nuclear energy operations, or nuclear engineering environments . 


This is a customer-facing role that requires strong project execution, technical coordination, documentation discipline, and the ability to manage implementation work in a highly regulated, safety-sensitive environment. 


The right candidate will be comfortable coordinating business, operational, engineering, technical, and vendor stakeholders while ensuring that implementation milestones, documentation, testing, rollout, and handover are completed with clarity and control. 


Key Responsibilities


  • Lead customer implementation projects from kickoff through deployment and operational handover.  
  • Coordinate implementation timelines, milestones, risks, dependencies, and status reporting.  
  • Serve as a primary point of contact during customer implementation phases.  
  • Work directly with customer operational, technical, engineering, and project stakeholders.  
  • Support implementation activities connected to nuclear power plant or nuclear energy environments.  
  • Manage implementation documentation, workflows, requirements, and customer-facing project materials.  
  • Coordinate testing, validation, issue resolution, rollout readiness, and go-live activities.  
  • Troubleshoot implementation blockers and coordinate internal or external support when needed.  
  • Ensure clear communication across customer teams, internal teams, vendors, and technical stakeholders.  
  • Support onboarding, user adoption, training coordination, and operational transition.  
  • Maintain disciplined project governance in environments with strict documentation, approval, and risk requirements.  
  • Support process improvement and standardization of implementation practices.  


Required Experience

  • Direct experience implementing software or operational systems for nuclear power generation customers is required. 
  • Experience managing technical, operational, infrastructure, engineering, or software implementation projects.  
  • Experience implementing software platforms, SaaS solutions, enterprise systems, maintenance systems, operational systems, or digital workflow solutions within nuclear power generation environments. 
  • Familiarity with common nuclear operations and maintenance systems, terminology, and workflows.  
  • Customer-facing project or implementation management experience.  
  • Strong stakeholder management across technical, operational, and executive audiences.  
  • Experience coordinating implementation documentation, project plans, timelines, risk logs, status reports, and handover materials.  
  • Experience supporting testing, rollout, deployment, commissioning, validation, or go-live activities.  
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.  
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving, remote environment.  
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and follow-through skills.  
  • Brazil-based or authorized to work from Brazil for this customer environment.  


Preferred Experience


  • Experience with systems such as IBM Maximo or similar enterprise asset management platforms is highly preferred. 
  • Experience implementing SaaS, enterprise software, operational systems, infrastructure systems, telecom systems, engineering systems, or project control platforms.  
  • Experience with U.S.-based customers or multinational stakeholders.  
  • Experience in highly regulated, safety-sensitive, or mission-critical environments.  
  • Familiarity with nuclear project documentation, approval workflows, testing discipline, operational restrictions, or regulated handover processes.  
  • Experience with change management, user adoption, customer onboarding, or operational rollout.  
  • Background in engineering, IT, telecom, infrastructure, industrial operations, project controls, or energy-related environments.  
  • Strong candidates may come from consulting, software implementation, or professional services organizations supporting nuclear energy customers.

title: Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Associate II, Pharmacovigilance - Brazil - Remote em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

What the Associate II, Pharmacovigilance does at Worldwide


Responsible for the collection, processing, evaluation and reporting of incoming Serious Adverse Event (SAE) data according to applicable regulatory guidelines/requirements, Worldwide Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project specific instructions. Serves as Lead PV Associate on moderate to large sized studies that are moderate to complex in scope of work with moderate support from senior staff.


What you will do


  • Author Safety Management Plan for assigned studies
  • Attend and present at Investigator Meetings
  • Review incoming SAE data for completeness and accuracy
  • Perform data entry in the Safety Database and/or complete applicable tracking of incoming safety information
  • Perform QC of SAEs processed by other PV Associates
  • Generate regulatory reports and perform safety submissions as needed


What you will bring to the role


  • Strong understanding of medical and scientific terminology, of the principles of clinical assessment of adverse drug events, of international regulations and of reporting requirements
  • Strong understanding of computer technology, and management of relational database systems, including extraction of data
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to handle multiple competing priorities within tight timelines
  • Consistently demonstrates commitment, dependability, cooperation, adaptability and flexibility in executing daily tasks and responsibilities


Your experience


  • Minimum of 3 years of pharmacovigilance experience (pre-approval clinical trials)
  • Bachelor’s degree in science related field, nursing or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience
  • Computer literacy and strong working knowledge of MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Excellent organization skills and attention to detail
  • Demonstrated ability to handle multiple competing priorities while adhering to applicable timelines
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work effectively and work successfully in matrix team environment
  • Ability and willingness for potential limited travel (domestic and international) as needed (attend Investigator Meeting, project kick-off meeting and/or bid defense meeting)
  • Fluent in written and verbal English

title: Software Engineer - UI
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer - UI em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Most frontend roles are just building screens.


This isn’t one of them.


This is a chance to own a real-time, collaborative, AI-native product surface - the part of the system where users actually work, make decisions, and rely on the output.


Think Notion or Google Docs-style interaction design, applied to a high-stakes domain where correctness and usability matter.


Why this role is interesting:


  • You’ll own state-heavy, collaborative UI systems , not just components
  • You’ll work on real-time multi-user editing and syncing problems
  • You’ll integrate AI directly into the product experience , not as a bolt-on
  • You’ll join a small, high-performing team with real product traction
  • You’ll have direct influence over product direction and UX standards


This is one of the highest-priority engineering hires on the team right now.


What you’ll be doing:


  • Building rich editing and collaboration experiences (shared editing, commenting, annotation)
  • Designing UI systems where multiple users interact in real time
  • Solving state, sync, and performance challenges across frontend and backend
  • Working closely with product and design to ship fast and iterate
  • Integrating AI workflows into user-facing interfaces


What they’re looking for:


  • 3+ years building complex web applications
  • Strong frontend foundation (React, TypeScript, Next.js)
  • Experience with rich UI, editing flows, or collaborative systems
  • Comfortable owning features end-to-end
  • High bar for product quality and interaction design


Strong signals:


  • ProseMirror, Tiptap, or Yjs
  • Real-time collaboration / multi-user systems
  • Editor or document-based product experience
  • AI or LLM workflows in product interfaces


Comp & setup:


  • Remote (US)
  • Small team, high ownership, fast-moving environment


Why it’s a good move:


If you’ve worked on editor-like or collaboration-heavy products before, this is a rare opportunity to go deeper on:


  • real-time systems
  • complex UI architecture
  • AI-native product design


…and do it in a setting where your work actually defines the product.

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Customer Service Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Service Representative em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Customer Service Representative

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Love helping people and solving problems fast? We’re looking for someone who can deliver high-quality customer experiences at scale, while keeping every interaction clear, human, and efficient. This is a hands-on role where responsiveness, empathy, and execution matter every day.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We create high-performance, eco-friendly cleaning solutions designed to make life easier without compromising sustainability.

Customer experience is at the core of our brand. Every interaction matters, and how we show up for our customers directly impacts retention, trust, and growth.


The Role

This is a high-volume, execution-focused role. You will manage day-to-day customer interactions across multiple channels, ensuring fast, accurate, and human responses.

You are not just answering tickets—you are shaping how customers experience the brand.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You communicate clearly, empathetically, and efficiently
  • You are comfortable handling high volumes of customer interactions
  • You stay calm under pressure and solve problems quickly
  • You pay attention to details and don’t let things slip
  • You take ownership of issues until they are fully resolved
  • You are comfortable working independently in a remote environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You avoid dealing with difficult customers
  • You prioritize speed over accuracy and quality
  • You are not comfortable multitasking across platforms


What You'll Do

Customer Support Execution

  • Manage and respond to customer inquiries via email and support platforms
  • Ensure fast, accurate, and high-quality responses at scale
  • Maintain a consistent and professional brand voice

Social Media Support

  • Respond to DMs and comments across platforms like Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
  • Engage with the community while maintaining brand tone and consistency

Order & Refund Management

  • Process order changes, cancellations, refunds, and exchanges
  • Ensure all actions follow company policies and are accurately executed

Conflict Resolution

  • Handle complaints with empathy and clarity
  • Investigate issues thoroughly and provide complete resolutions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer feedback and recurring issues with internal teams
  • Help identify patterns that can improve product or operations


Requirements

Must have:

  • Experience in customer service (ecommerce or DTC preferred)
  • Strong written communication skills in English

title: ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor in USD em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.


EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.


Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.


Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;


Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
  • Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;

ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);

ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
  • Fluent in English;

title: Project Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Project Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Ten16 Creative is looking for a mid-level Project Manager based in Brazil to help keep our creative work clear, organized, and moving forward. Ten16 is a creative partner for technology-driven companies, helping teams turn complex products into clear, market-ready brand, campaign, design, web, video, and motion experiences. Our clients operate across areas such as AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, consumer electronics, connected hardware, and B2B technology.


This is a remote contractor position for someone who is experienced enough to manage multiple moving pieces with confidence, but still hands-on, adaptable, and eager to grow with a fast-moving creative team. The right person will bring structure to creative work without slowing it down. They will help coordinate timelines, deliverables, client communication, internal reviews, production details, and day-to-day follow-through across projects that often involve strategy, design, writing, motion, video, web, and campaign development.


About Ten16 Creative

Ten16 Creative is a global creative studio with roots in the United States and São Paulo. We help tech-driven companies make complex products easier to understand, trust, and bring to market. Our work spans brand identity, campaign development, design systems, web design, presentations, marketing assets, video, motion, 3D animation, AI-powered production, and creative leadership.


We work with companies that need a creative partner who can bring clarity, consistency, and structure to sophisticated products. Our clients have included technology, AI, SaaS, gaming, entertainment, and consumer electronics brands, with representative work across companies and projects in various tech-driven spaces.


About the Role

The Project Manager will be responsible for helping Ten16 plan, coordinate, and deliver creative projects from kickoff through final delivery. This person will work closely with creative directors, designers, producers, writers, motion teams, developers, and clients to make sure everyone understands what needs to happen, when it needs to happen, and what is required to deliver excellent work.


This role is ideal for someone who has already worked in an agency, creative studio, production company, marketing team, or digital product environment and understands how creative work moves from brief to execution. The role does not require senior-level account leadership, but it does require organization, fluent English and Portuguese communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.


You will manage active project timelines and ensure that milestones, deliverables, meetings, and reviews are clearly documented and communicated. You will help turn creative scopes into practical schedules, making sure that internal team members understand priorities and that clients understand what is needed from them to keep projects moving.


You will coordinate daily and weekly project activity across brand, design, web, video, motion, campaign, and presentation work. This includes assigning or tracking tasks, following up on open items, preparing meeting agendas, documenting decisions, and making sure feedback is captured accurately. You will also help maintain project management tools, shared folders, project boards, calendars, and production documents so the team always has a reliable source of truth.


You will support client-facing communication in English with professionalism and clarity. This may include sending status updates, recapping meetings, organizing feedback, preparing for presentations, and helping the team stay ahead of deadlines. Because Ten16 works with technology-driven companies, you should be comfortable working on projects where the subject matter may be complex, technical, or still evolving.


You will help protect the quality of the work by making sure deliverables are complete, organized, properly labeled, and ready for review or delivery. You will not be expected to creative-direct the work, but you should have a strong eye for detail and enough creative production experience to recognize when something is missing, unclear, or not ready to send.


Qualifications

The ideal candidate has approximately 3–5 years of experience in project management, creative production, account coordination, marketing operations, agency operations, or a related role. They should have experience managing creative deliverables and coordinating cross-functional teams in a remote environment.


They must be located in Brazil and must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. English fluency is essential because the role will involve written and spoken communication with U.S.-based team members and clients. Portuguese fluency is equally important for collaboration with Brazil-based team members and vendors.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado] em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Front End Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Front End Engineer



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience

• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Consulting Partner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Consulting Partner em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ERA Group, a global leader in cost management and business optimisation, is looking for an entrepreneurial Partner to join our international network of consultants.

This is not a traditional consultancy role; it’s a chance to run your own practice within a global brand, with the freedom to shape your market, build your team, and grow your client base while backed by ERA’s proven methodologies, tools, and worldwide community.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead cost optimisation, procurement, and performance improvement programmes across industries
  • Build and grow your client portfolio through business development and long-term partnerships
  • Take ownership of your practice’s strategic direction, go-to-market approach, and team leadership
  • Work directly with C-level clients to deliver measurable savings and transformation


What You Bring

  • Extensive consulting or senior leadership experience in cost management, procurement, or performance improvement
  • A strong track record of client acquisition and project delivery
  • Deep expertise in one or more industries such as Pharma/Life Sciences, Energy/Utilities, Manufacturing, Consumer, or Logistics
  • Confidence in engaging with CxO-level stakeholders and leveraging your professional network
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with the ambition to grow a successful consulting practice



This is the ideal next step if you’re seeking less bureaucracy, more independence, and the chance to build something of your own within a global consultancy platform.


By applying, you agree to the use of your personal data for recruitment and related communications, in accordance with the UK GDPR.

description:

Muito além de uma consultoria, somos um ecossistema de soluções em gestão e estruturação de negócios que transformarão o futuro do turismo. Temos 4 grupos de soluções para as áreas de hospitalidade, entretenimento e destinos turísticos: 


  • Estratégia & Desenvolvimento: Estruturação e viabilidade de novos negócios; 
  • Operação & Performance: Asset Management, eficiência operacional e novas receitas 
  • Revenue Management & Analytics: inteligência de mercado e análise de tendências; 
  • Produto & Inovação: Novos produtos, marcas e experiências. 


Assim como a coruja, que inspirou o nosso nome, utilizamos nossa sabedoria e visão aguçada para alçar voos cada vez mais altos. Trabalhamos com verdade e nos envolvemos em projetos em que acreditamos, pois sabemos que o êxito é maior quando alinhamos interesses com todos que caminham com a gente.

Aqui, prezamos por um ambiente de trabalho leve, flexível, ético, inovador, íntegro e que valoriza a autonomia de cada colaborador. Todas as opiniões e sugestões são muito bem-vindas e respeitadas. Buscamos quem partilha desses princípios e acredita ser possível fazer diferente e ir além.

O SEU DIA A DIA COM A GENTE  

  • Atuação em projetos de viabilidade econômica, valuations, planos de negócio, planejamento estratégico e planos de expansões nas áreas de hospitalidade e entretenimento; 
  • Participação na elaboração de nossos estudos setoriais; 
  • Envolvimento na estruturação, implantação e concepção de negócios do setor; 
  • Organização e participação em viagens de campo (quando possível); 
  • Análise de indicadores e pesquisas de benchmarking; 
  • Local de trabalho: remoto. Possibilidade de encontros presenciais em São Paulo (capital) de acordo com a disponibilidade do colaborador. 

PERFIL DO CANDIDATO  

  • Formado ou cursando hotelaria, turismo, administração, economia ou áreas correlatas e, o mais importante, se interessar pelos setores em que atuamos; 
  • Raciocínio lógico, boa capacidade analítica e excelente capacidade de comunicação oral e escrita; 
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender; 
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes; 
  • Inglês avançado; 
  • Desejável conhecimento das ferramentas Microsoft Excel e Power Point. 

BENEFÍCIOS  

  • Salário de acordo com a vaga;
  • Bônus por desempenho (para analista e consultor);
  • Seguro de vida; 
  • Vale refeição; 
  • Auxílio transporte; 
  • Treinamentos de capacitação com materiais de aulas ministradas em cursos de pós-graduação.

title: Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Performance Governance Analyst (KPI & Service Excellence) para atuar na estruturação, evolução e governança do framework de indicadores de excelência de serviços do Centro de Serviços Compartilhados (CSC).

Essa pessoa terá atuação estratégica, sendo responsável por garantir a consistência, padronização e relevância dos indicadores utilizados na gestão da performance, ao mesmo tempo em que apoia a construção e evolução de métricas sempre que necessário.

O papel exige forte interface com áreas de negócio, operação e times de dados/BI, traduzindo necessidades operacionais e estratégicas em indicadores acionáveis, confiáveis e alinhados aos objetivos do CSC.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Estruturar, evoluir e governar o framework de indicadores de desempenho do CSC;
  • Garantir padronização metodológica, clareza conceitual e rastreabilidade dos indicadores;
  • Atuar na definição de conceitos, fórmulas, regras de cálculo e critérios de análise;
  • Identificar e priorizar lacunas de mensuração nos pilares de custo, prazo e qualidade;
  • Conduzir ciclos de validação junto às áreas de negócio e stakeholders;
  • Atuar na priorização e gestão do backlog de indicadores considerando impacto e viabilidade;
  • Apoiar a construção de frameworks de governança e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Monitorar a maturidade dos indicadores e propor evoluções contínuas;
  • Realizar interface com times de BI e dados para implementação das métricas;
  • Traduzir demandas estratégicas e operacionais em indicadores acionáveis e mensuráveis;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva, apoiando a tomada de decisão baseada em dados.


Requisitos e qualificações

Obrigatórios:

  • Graduação ou pós-graduação em TI, Engenharia, Estatística, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Vivência com definição, estruturação e governança de KPIs e métricas operacionais;
  • Experiência em atuação com stakeholders e áreas de negócio;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de performance e gestão de indicadores;
  • Capacidade de atuar tanto em nível estratégico quanto em detalhamento conceitual de indicadores.


Desejáveis:

  • Experiência com CSC (Centro de Serviços Compartilhados);
  • Conhecimentos em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau, etc.);
  • Experiência em ambientes de Data & Analytics;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma);
  • Vivência em projetos com grandes empresas ou ambientes complexos.

Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced techno

logies.We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their m

arkets.To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive techno

logies.We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional


growth.
